scripts.db:destroy: docker compose exec -T db dropdb --if-exists -U postgres atlas
scripts.db:create: docker compose exec -T db createdb -U postgres atlas
scripts.db:setup: docker compose exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d atlas < db/local/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d atlas < db/local/seed.sql
scripts.db:sync: bun run db:destroy && bun run db:create && bun run db:setup && bun run db:seed && bun run db:codegen
scripts.auth:schema: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS better_auth_ddl' -c 'CREATE DATABASE better_auth_ddl' && bunx @better-auth/cli generate --config scripts/better-auth-cli-config.ts --output db/local/spec/better-auth-schema.sql --yes && docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS better_auth_ddl'
